description: A small creek of liquid rubber flows slowly between the trees. The sound is a dull, rhythmic thudding.

ground.description: The muddy bank of the rubber creek.

rubber_well.onInteract: You peer into the miniature bubbling warm spring. Rich, black liquid rubber bubbles up from deep underground, warm and smooth.
rubber_well.description: A natural warm bubbling spring of liquid rubber.

item.name: Wild Potato
item.opened_description: A heavy stone at the water's edge. Just mud remains underneath.
item.onCollect: You roll over the mossy stepping stone and find a perfectly round Wild Potato nestled in the wet mud!

mossy_stepping_stone.description: A large, slick stepping stone covered in bright green moss.

creek.description: A slow-moving stream of thick, black liquid rubber.
creek.effectMessage: The rubber is thick and hard to walk through!

exit_east.description: The path leads east toward the thorny thicket.
